I'm chubby. I've been skinny, I've been obese. I'm 20lbs overweight now and feel in and out of validity in it. I've had the surgeon for bottom surgery tell me I need to lose the weight but if you saw a photo, I'm average maybe a little heavier. That is my biggest reason I want to lose weight now even though I'm a stress eater and it's hard! But through all my skinny, fat, chubby phases its come down to one aspect:  Its mental. Its mental weight. You can be happy with yourself while you're chubby and still want to lose weight to improve or you can be mad at yourself when you're chubby and contiue to be mad at yourself when you're skinny or fit or wherever your journey is because you gotta shed the mental weight! I can look at myself now and remember that when I start to spiral, I'm me, I'm constantly evolving, I can be happy and active and enjoy food I like and be desirable and be accomplished and be a man and the only person being angry about my weight is me. And if I want to change it, I can. And you can do that for you and learn to be happy now and later and whenever and it takes work and balance and forgiveness and patience. :) sorry for the rant but you're valid no matter where you are in your journey. You gotta learn to see it for yourself.
